description: This file defines interfaces related to font resolving within the PDFsharp library, including marker and resolver interfaces for converting typeface requests into physical font data.

classes.name: IFontResolverMarker
classes.description: A marker interface used to categorize different font resolver implementations.

classes.name: IFontResolver
classes.description: Provides methods to convert font requests into font data, including resolving typefaces and retrieving font bytes.

classes.name: IFontResolver2
classes.description: An extended font resolver interface that offers additional style parameters for resolving typefaces and an alternative method for retrieving font data.

methods.name: ResolveTypeface (string familyName, bool bold, bool italic)
methods.description: Resolves a typeface by family name and style (bold/italic), returning font information or null if unavailable.

methods.name: GetFont (string faceName)
methods.description: Retrieves the font byte data associated with a face name, returning null if not available.

methods.name: ResolveTypeface (string familyName, XFontStyle style, XFontWeight weight, XFontStretch stretch)
methods.description: Resolves a typeface with detailed style parameters, returning font info or null.

methods.name: GetFont (string faceName) [in IFontResolver2]
methods.description: Retrieves font data as ReadOnlyMemory<byte> for a given face name.

calls: ResolveTypeface (string familyName, bool bold, bool italic)
ResolveTypeface (string familyName, XFontStyle style, XFontWeight weight, XFontStretch stretch)
